# pop cashout

EOA cash-out discovery and explicit recovery

## pop cashout payload

Encode an unsigned opt-in cashout schema payload from explicit quote fields

```text
pop cashout payload [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--conversion-rate` | string | yes | - | Explicit conversion rate (18 decimals) |
| `--depositor` | string | yes | - | EOA depositor address |
| `--fiat-currency` | string | yes | - | Fiat currency bytes32 |
| `--max-amount` | string | yes | - | Maximum intent in 6-decimal token units |
| `--min-amount` | string | yes | - | Minimum intent in 6-decimal token units |
| `--payee-details-hash` | string | yes | - | Payee details bytes32 digest |
| `--payment-method` | string | yes | - | Payment method bytes32 |

## pop cashout deposit-from-receipt

Resolve an exact escrow deposit from one chain-checked receipt

```text
pop cashout deposit-from-receipt [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--address` | string | no | - | Observe as this account without a key |
| `--deposit` | string | no | - | Optional known deposit ID to narrow ambiguous logs |
| `--escrow` | string | yes | - | Explicit escrow address |
| `--relay` | string | yes | - | Explicit cashout relay address |
| `--rpc` | string | yes | - | RPC endpoint for the explicitly selected external chain |
| `--token` | string | yes | - | Explicit USDC token address |
| `--transaction` | string | yes | - | Exact cashout deposit transaction hash |

| `--rpc` | string | yes | - | RPC endpoint for the explicitly selected external chain |
| `--token` | string | yes | - | Explicit USDC token address |

## pop cashout discover

Enumerate external cashout candidates; pinned RPC still determines recoverability

```text
pop cashout discover [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--address` | string | no | - | Observe as this account without a key |
| `--escrow` | string | yes | - | Explicit escrow address |
| `--max-pages` | number | no | `20` | Finite cap per status stream |
| `--page-size` | number | no | `100` | Candidate page size (1–1000) |
| `--relay` | string | yes | - | Explicit cashout relay address |
| `--rpc` | string | yes | - | RPC endpoint for the explicitly selected external chain |
| `--subgraph` | string | yes | - | Explicit single-relay indexed endpoint |
| `--token` | string | yes | - | Explicit USDC token address |
